description: Experimental community port of the Nemotron-H speech language model for offline transcription, translation, audio questions, language identification, word timestamps and speaker labels.

request.name: instruct
request.description: Audio instruction or question. Replaces the template instruction; defaults to text_input when present. Chat controls and audio locators are rejected.

request.name: template_name
request.description: Instruction template. Audio Q&A requires instruct or text_input. Timestamps and speakers require the default transcription template.

request.name: language
request.description: Source language hint for the default transcription prompt. An explicit instruct replaces this prompt, including its language hint.

request.name: target_language
request.description: Target language for the translation template.

request.name: system_prompt
request.description: Optional system message; the trained default is empty.

request.name: return_timestamps
request.description: Run the checkpoint CTC head for source-language word timestamps. Failed streams return no fabricated word rows.

request.name: diarization
request.description: Request speaker-tagged transcription, CTC words and speaker activity turns. An explicit instruct must request speaker tags itself.

request.name: max_tokens
request.description: Maximum generated response tokens. Defaults to generation_config or native duration budget max(24,ceil(6*audio_seconds)+24). Prompt and output must fit max_context.

request.name: do_sample
request.description: Sample tokens instead of greedy decoding.

request.name: temperature
request.description: Positive sampling temperature when do_sample is true.

request.name: top_k
request.description: Sampling candidate count; zero disables top-k filtering.

session.name: weight_type
session.description: Native preserves mixed packaged tensor types. Changing this may greatly increase model memory.

session.name: max_context
session.description: Combined text, audio and output context, bounded by backbone positions. Matches native SALM serving default.

session.name: prefill_batch_size
session.description: Text/audio rows per decoder prefill graph.

session.name: flash_attention
session.description: Use flash attention in the speech and speaker encoders.

session.name: encoder_window_size
session.description: Core encoder window in 80 ms output frames; the native default is 40 seconds.

session.name: encoder_left_context
session.description: Encoder window left context in 80 ms frames.

session.name: encoder_right_context
session.description: Encoder window right context in 80 ms frames.

session.name: speaker_cache_size
session.description: Native serving speaker cache in 80 ms frames, distinct from training configuration. At least two rows per speaker are required.

session.name: speaker_fifo_size
session.description: Recent speaker FIFO size in 80 ms frames.

session.name: speaker_update_period
session.description: Native serving speaker-cache update period in 80 ms frames.
